assign.request: figure out why the framework/ai2/ new card -> dictation works but the fast assistant isn't able to respond; double recordings from nested card mic; fast assistant should respond and spawn minions that respond; framework/ai2/live/ card with usage bars, running agents, major tasks, bump on update, clearable, bottom log where dictations go — each page a chat room
steps: Chat log footer on every card

assign.outcome:
**Cards on AI 2 are now chat rooms, and the assistant's replies reach them. There is a Live card too.**

- Why the assistant seemed silent: it was replying all along, but only into the `prompts` log. The card page reads the card's own log, and nothing copied the replies over. Now they are copied.
- One microphone at a time: starting any mic stops the other one. A sentence spoken into a sub-card stays in that sub-card's chat.
- Agents can talk into cards: a new `card_reply` tool. The assistant can start a read-only helper (`help`). Task masterminds are told the card to answer in. Both stay off while `dispatch.off` exists.
- [Live card](/framework/ai2/live/): usage bars, running agents and today's tasks. It moves to the top of the list when anything changes, has a ✕ to clear items, and ends in a chat of updates.
- Fixed a crash: while paused, the Dispatcher kept hearing its own notes. It wrote 294 MB in 90 s and Servex ran out of memory. The log is trimmed, and the bloated copy is in `servex/backup/`.
